rule: ALL 6 Required plus ANY 5 of 11 Alternates.
signoff: The Lodge Master and the Lodge Secretary sign off, with dates. This on-site tracker is only a personal aid; it is not a substitute for the official signed form.
submit: Submit the completed form with a cover letter saying why the candidate is worthy to The Grand Master's Office, 222 Taunton Avenue, East Providence, RI 02914-4556.

required.text: Attend each of the blue lodge degrees at least once, but at other lodge.
Attend at least one visit of the lodge's D.D.G.M. to another lodge in one of the Districts.
Attend at least seven stated lodge communications over the course of 18 months.
Work on at least one lodge social activity or lodge charitable event.
Assist at least once with the officers setting up the lodge room (at a meeting or rehearsal).
Attend a Grand Lodge sponsored educational program.

alternates.text: Sponsor at least one candidate into the lodge.
Assist at least once with the preparation of candidate(s) before the degree, or assist in a cipher training for another candidate.
Assist in serving/preparation/setup/cleanup of a lodge dinner meeting or breakfast.
Assist in serving at a Table Lodge within Rhode Island.
Assist in a lodge Open House or Membership drive event.
Assist in a CHIP Program event or a Blood Drive within a district.
Attend a DeMolay or Rainbow meeting, event, or installation.
Visit a lodge member in a nursing home, hospital or home (who can't get to meetings).
Assist in the delivery of flowers to a Special Lady.
Accompany an investigation team of a petitioner.
